description: I'm a CSE student from Bangladesh interested in AGI-inspired systems, AI/ML, quantum-inspired computing, cybersecurity, and space technology. I want to build an AI-powered space mission planning and simulation prototype using NASA data. I'm looking for teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, astronomy, physics, optimization, data science, and web development. Creativity, teamwork, and a passion for space exploration are welcome!
summary:
MissionForge is an educational space mission design and simulation prototype developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, under the Space Mission Design Game challenge.

The project explores how interactive software can support the conceptual design and evaluation of space missions. It provides a mission-building interface with synthetic educational profiles and simulation workflows, allowing users to explore mission-planning concepts in a structured environment.

Our goal is to make space mission design more accessible by combining software engineering, visualization, and computational thinking. The prototype is designed as an educational demonstration rather than a validated spacecraft engineering or orbital prediction system.

MissionForge represents our team's exploration of accessible, interactive tools for understanding the complexity of space mission planning.
details:
Project Overview

MissionForge is an educational prototype exploring interactive space mission design and simulation.

How It Works

The application provides a mission-building interface, synthetic educational profiles, and mission simulation workflows. Users can explore the structure of mission planning through an interactive software environment.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to make space mission planning concepts easier to understand and explore. It provides an accessible starting point for students and technology enthusiasts interested in space science, computational modeling, and mission design.

Technologies

The implementation uses Python, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web-based visualization technologies. Additional technologies should be listed only where they are actually implemented.

Creativity and Innovation

The project combines software engineering, interactive mission workflows, and educational simulation concepts into a single prototype.

Limitations

The current prototype uses synthetic educational data. It is not a validated spacecraft engineering tool and does not provide verified orbital predictions, real fuel estimates, or operational mission recommendations.
